$comment: ZIM knowledge packs (PR #294 → issue #301): the required-check inventory. One row per named automated test or piece of required manual evidence behind the wave's acceptance matrix (T01–T19 gate the #294 merge; T20 gates the post-merge provisioning phase P8). Validated by repo-hygiene.test.ts: every implemented / baseline-pending row must name a test that exists in the named file with the matching form (`it(` vs `it.fails(`); every it.fails in the ZIM suites must be a baseline-pending row here; no .skip/.todo/.only anywhere in the ZIM suites; every manual-evidence row says where its evidence is or that it is still pending and who owns it. Statuses: implemented | baseline-pending (an it.fails that the owning phase flips) | pending (the owning phase has not landed the case yet; file/test name the planned home) | manual-evidence (recorded evidence, never a dummy test). A pending row is never represented by a passing dummy test. Phase PRs update this file; P7 requires every P7-gated row to be implemented or recorded manual evidence.
